headline: Apple to scan public iCloud share links for harmful content
summary: Apple will begin scanning iCloud items shared via public links for "harmful content" starting with iOS 27.3, though it has not defined the term and may ban policy violators.

claims.statement: Apple will begin scanning iCloud items shared via public links for "harmful content" starting with iOS 27.3.

sources.quote: Apple will monitor your public iCloud links now, starting with iOS 27.3
Apple will check shared iCloud links for ‘harmful content’

claims.statement: Apple has not defined what counts as "harmful content" under the new policy.

sources.quote: though the iMaker hasn't defined that term

claims.statement: Apple may ban users who violate the new policy.
